categories.main_business_segments: CROSS CAT operates primarily in the information services sector, focusing on system solutions (software development, system operation and maintenance, technical support, system consulting, and infrastructure support), business intelligence (BI) services, original software and hardware solutions, and staff services (technical and clerical staffing, outsourcing, and job placement). The company and its three consolidated subsidiaries form a group structure, with all entities engaged in similar IT-related service activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced application development technologies, project management methodologies (including CMMI Level 5 and QMS), and expertise in cloud, AI, and DX (digital transformation) solutions. Software development is managed through project-based progress accounting, with revenue recognized based on completion rates. The company also offers proprietary SaaS and packaged solutions, and emphasizes robust quality and security management (ISO9001, ISO27001, ISMS).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large manufacturers, system integrators, financial institutions (banks, credit card companies, insurance), public sector entities (government agencies, municipalities, public enterprises), and companies in manufacturing, communications, distribution, and media. Major end clients include Fujitsu, NTT Data, and the National Tax Agency, reflecting a strong presence in finance and public sector IT systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Japan, with headquarters in Tokyo and subsidiaries in Osaka, Tokyo, and Sendai. All sales and assets are domestic, with no significant overseas operations or assets reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: CROSS CAT operates primarily as a downstream IT service provider, delivering end-to-end system integration, software development, and IT consulting directly to enterprise and public sector clients. The company also acts as a midstream partner for major system integrators and manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transitioning to a value-added service model, expanding asset-based business by leveraging accumulated know-how, strengthening the end-user customer base, investing in human capital, and maximizing group synergies. R&D focuses on DX, AI, cloud, and data utilization, with ongoing development of proprietary SaaS and AI solutions. The company also emphasizes sustainability, diversity, and organizational engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based system development, ongoing system operation and maintenance contracts, consulting, BI implementation, and sales of proprietary software and SaaS solutions. Additional revenue streams include hardware sales, technical staffing, and outsourcing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CROSS CAT is positioned as an independent (non-affiliated) information services company, competing with major system integrators and IT service firms in Japan. Key competitors include large SIers and IT consulting firms, but the company differentiates itself through its independence, long-term relationships in finance and public sectors, and proprietary solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 16.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.84 billion yen and net profit of 1.32 billion yen. The company has achieved four consecutive years of record sales and profits, with an 8.5% year-on-year sales increase and a workforce of 856 employees. The company targets medium-term growth to 30 billion yen in sales and 3 billion yen in operating profit.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CROSS CAT emphasizes high-quality, efficient, and specialized IT services, leveraging deep domain expertise in finance and public sectors, robust project management, and proprietary solutions (including SaaS and AI products). The company positions itself as a trusted, independent partner capable of flexible, customer-first solutions and long-term value creation, with a focus on customer success and sustainable business practices.
